Desc.SourceString: 至少得开怀大笑，不是吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: When all else fails, at least you can squeeze out a good laugh, am I right?

Desc.LocalizedString: I am inevitable!

Desc.SourceString: 轻车熟路，又到终点。
Desc.LocalizedString: We've been down this road before.

Desc.SourceString: 我来拦着，你们上！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll hold the line, keep pushing forward!

Desc.LocalizedString: I'll hold the line, keep pushing forward!

Desc.LocalizedString: I'll hold the line, keep pushing forward!

Desc.SourceString: 我来拦着，你们上！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll hold the line, keep pushing forward!

Desc.SourceString: 新手的运气总是特别好，别惹新手！
Desc.LocalizedString: Rookies have beginner's luck. Don't mess with them!

Desc.SourceString: 你去外面打听打听我是谁，无人不知，无人不晓。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ask people who I am. Everyone knows me.

Desc.SourceString: 漫漫长路，感谢有你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Glad to have you with me on this long journey.

Desc.SourceString: 漫漫长路，感谢有你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Glad to have you with me on this long journey.

Desc.SourceString: 漫漫长路，感谢有你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Glad to have you with me on this long journey.

Desc.SourceString: 漫漫长路，感谢有你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Glad to have you with me on this long journey.

Desc.SourceString: 漫漫长路，感谢有你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Glad to have you with me on this long journey.

Desc.SourceString: ……然后把你们都送上天！
Desc.LocalizedString: ...and I'll blast you all away!

Desc.SourceString: 我不喜欢争斗，但如果和其他人发生争斗，我会赢！
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't like fighting, but if you insist, I'll destroy you.

Desc.SourceString: 眼中无枪，心中有枪。
Desc.LocalizedString: Do not aim with your eyes. Aim with your heart.

Desc.SourceString: 卡丘人每次濒死时都会变得更强大……开玩笑的，没这种事。
Desc.LocalizedString: They say whatever doesn't kill you makes you stronger. Hah! It doesn't.

Desc.SourceString: 还有王法吗！还有法律吗！
Desc.LocalizedString: Is there no justice? No law?

Desc.SourceString: 横冲直撞，无人能挡！
Desc.LocalizedString: I am Death, the destroyer of worlds!

Desc.SourceString: 我走过了，你们倒下了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I've passed through, and you've fallen.

Desc.SourceString: 胜利是对坚守者最好的奖赏。
Desc.LocalizedString: Victory is the best reward for those who persevere.

Desc.SourceString: 运气，也是实力的一部分。
Desc.LocalizedString: Luck is part of skill too.

Desc.SourceString: 不客气，这是我应该做的。你帮我，我帮你，我们把把在一起~
Desc.LocalizedString: You're welcome. It's what I'm here for. You'll help me, I'll help you. We're in this together!

Desc.SourceString: 你们五个一起上，我在赶时间。
Desc.LocalizedString: Come at me, I've got no time to spare.

Desc.SourceString: 打了我还想跑？
Desc.LocalizedString: Think you can run?

Desc.SourceString: 你给我下来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Get down here!

Desc.SourceString: 弦化虽好，但我技高一筹~
Desc.LocalizedString: Stringification is impressive, but I'm simply superior!

Desc.SourceString: 抽取弦能是一项工作，更是一种艺术。
Desc.LocalizedString: Extracting String Energy is not just a job; it's an art.

Desc.SourceString: 完美演化的自然之星，成就着自然壮丽之美。
Desc.LocalizedString: A perfectly evolved natural star, achieving the grandeur of nature.

Desc.SourceString: 科创推演的科研之星，成就着人类科技的智慧之美。
Desc.LocalizedString: A research star of scientific and technological innovation, achieving the beauty of human technological wisdom.

Desc.SourceString: 生命繁荣的生命之星，成就着生命崇高之美。
Desc.LocalizedString: A flourishing living star, achieving the sublime beauty of life.

Desc.SourceString: 引航者要看到的，往往是常人难以察觉的真相。
Desc.LocalizedString: What you have to find, Navigator, is the truth unperceivable to the untrained eye.

Desc.SourceString: 蝴蝶拍打翅膀，随后掀起飓风。
Desc.LocalizedString: A butterfly flaps its wings, and a hurricane ensues.

Desc.SourceString: 如同太阳一般，冉冉升起的新星。
Desc.LocalizedString: A rising star as bright as the sun.

Desc.SourceString: 仿照黑猫先生自画像制作，带有白墨签名的定制徽章——用以纪念那场特别的“黑猫行动”。
Desc.LocalizedString: A custom badge modeled after Mr. Black Cat's self-portrait, with a white ink signature—commemorating the special "Black Cat Operation."

Desc.SourceString: 所有人目光的中心、派对的焦点——就是你啦！生日快乐哦！
Desc.LocalizedString: You're the center of everyone's attention, the life of the party—happy birthday!

Desc.SourceString: 愿星星常伴你的美梦，愿你的美梦里总能见到星星。
Desc.LocalizedString: May stars always grace your dreams, filling them with celestial light.

Desc.SourceString: 暂时停下，是为了更好的出发
Desc.LocalizedString: Stopping now for a better journey ahead.

Desc.SourceString: 让食物变美味的秘诀……是真心，我加了真心！
Desc.LocalizedString: The secret ingredient to tasty food... is sincerity. I cooked with all my heart!

Desc.SourceString: 吉星高照喵喵喵，福来财来好运到~
Desc.LocalizedString: Lucky meow, fortune awaits!

Desc.SourceString: 把心事与愿望寄托给漂流瓶，或许它能够漂洋过海，乘着海风与浪，来到那个人身边。
Desc.LocalizedString: Send your hopes and dreams adrift in a bottle; maybe they’ll sail across the ocean and reach that special someone.

Desc.SourceString: 海洋、音浪、原野、沙滩……这是最好的夏夜。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oceans, music, open fields, and sandy beaches... the ultimate summer night.

Desc.SourceString: 我能感觉到你对他们深深的爱。
Desc.LocalizedString: I feel your deep love for them.

Desc.SourceString: 真正浪漫主义的人可以拿枪来当乐器！
Desc.LocalizedString: A true romantic can use a gun as a musical instrument!

Desc.SourceString: 纪念那些喜欢射击游戏的玩家。
Desc.LocalizedString: For players who love shooting games.

Desc.SourceString: 挑战极限，成就自我无限光辉。
Desc.LocalizedString: Challenge your limits and seize ultimate glory.

Desc.SourceString: 引航者，未来就在你的手中。
Desc.LocalizedString: The future is in your hands, Navigator.

Desc.SourceString:
KQ0100年，面对崩溃症带来的巨大隐患，欧泊启动百年轮回计划。
由此，世界陷入矛盾与悲剧的螺旋。
Desc.LocalizedString: In the year KQ0100, to counter the devastating threat of Collapse Syndrome, P.U.S. launched the Hundred-Year Restoration Initiative. This thrust the world into a spiral of conflict and tragedy.

Desc.SourceString: 乌尔比诺财团欢迎您的加入！
Desc.LocalizedString: Welcome to Urbino Business Alliance!

Desc.SourceString: 那些用灵魂铸造徽记的人，永远也不可能向命运屈服。因为他们代表的是最硬派的勇士，‌淬炼出了钢铁般的意志。
Desc.LocalizedString: Those who forge with their soul refuse to surrender to fate, representing the mightiest warriors with steel-like resolve.

Desc.SourceString: 检测到剧烈弦能反应，加速进化中。
Desc.LocalizedString: Detected intense String Energy! Accelerating evolution.

Desc.SourceString: 押注在卡牌之上的，是真心，还是下注的筹码？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is it your heart on the line or just your chips?

Desc.SourceString: 我们汇集成点。
Desc.LocalizedString: We gather as one.

Desc.SourceString: 我们彼此连结.
Desc.LocalizedString: We are united.

Desc.SourceString: 我们无所不在。
Desc.LocalizedString: We are omnipresent.

Desc.SourceString: 我们跨越一切！
Desc.LocalizedString: We transcend all!

Desc.SourceString: 乌尔比诺，支持每一个人去追求独属于自己的那份艺术感。
Desc.LocalizedString: Urbino encourages everyone to pursue their unique sense of artistry.

Desc.SourceString: “守信之心”是颁发给讲信誉、守信用之人的最高奖励。遇到佩戴“守信之心”的小伙伴，请不要吝惜自己的夸赞哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: The Heart of Integrity is the highest award given to individuals who demonstrate honesty and reliability. If you meet someone wearing it, don't hesitate to shower them with praise!

Desc.SourceString: 你对瓶中之物的每一次提炼，都有可能诞生惊喜。
Desc.LocalizedString: Each time you distill the contents of the bottle, a surprise may emerge.

Desc.SourceString: 在卡丘夺旗阵营战中，为对欧泊阵营做出特殊贡献者设计的专属徽章。众志成城，无往不胜。
Desc.LocalizedString: Exclusive medal for outstanding contributions to the P.U.S faction in capture the flag. United we prevail.

Desc.SourceString: 在卡丘夺旗阵营战中，为代表欧泊阵营出战之人设计的专属徽章。
Desc.LocalizedString: Exclusive medal for P.U.S representatives in Capture the Flag.

Desc.SourceString: 在卡丘夺旗阵营战中，为对乌尔比诺阵营做出特殊贡献者设计的专属徽章。航路未尽，终抵自由。
Desc.LocalizedString: Exclusive medal for outstanding contributions to the Urbino faction in Capture the Flag. Journey onward to freedom.

Desc.SourceString: 在卡丘夺旗阵营战中，为代表乌尔比诺阵营出战之人设计的专属徽章。
Desc.LocalizedString: Exclusive medal for Urbino representatives in Capture the Flag.

Desc.SourceString: 在卡丘夺旗阵营战中，为对剪刀手阵营做出特殊贡献者设计的专属徽章。前路虚妄，锐意永存。
Desc.LocalizedString: Exclusive medal for outstanding contributions to the The Scissors faction in Capture the Flag. Ever sharp and undaunted.

Desc.SourceString: 在卡丘夺旗阵营战中，为代表剪刀手阵营出战之人设计的专属徽章。
Desc.LocalizedString: Exclusive medal for The Scissors representatives in Capture the Flag.

Desc.SourceString: 弦海中探明的蚀刻痕迹足以证明，剑术绝非不便之物，付诸双手只是伎俩，藏于心中才是技艺！
Desc.LocalizedString: Holding a sword is mere skill; true mastery lies within the heart!

Desc.SourceString: 弦海中的古老徽印，深刻地凝视其中，会感觉世界渐渐失去形状与色彩，变为一片纯白。
Desc.LocalizedString: Gaze into this ancient emblem, and see the world fade into pure white.

Desc.SourceString: 弦海中的古老徽印，深刻地凝视其中，会感觉思维与行动都逐渐停滞……
Desc.LocalizedString: Gazing deeply into the ancient emblem slows your mind and movements to a standstill...

Desc.SourceString: 翻涌的浪潮，将揭开新的篇章。
Desc.LocalizedString: The surging tidal wave will reveal a new chapter.

Desc.SourceString: 飞行的故事，始于一只由梦想折叠而成的纸飞机。那一次次放飞纸飞机的憧憬，累积成力量，最终让我们突破神话的想象、跨越工业的局限，铸就了征服天际的战鹰。
Desc.LocalizedString: The story of flight started with a dream-folded paper plane. Each launch fueled our aspirations, empowering us to transcend myths and industrial limits, eventually crafting the majestic aircraft that commands the skies.

Desc.SourceString: 乌尔比诺商业联盟为VIP客户准备的生日蛋糕，虽然造型抽象，但饱含心意。主原料为芒果和巧克力。
Desc.LocalizedString: A birthday cake prepared by the Urbino Business Alliance for VIP clients. Its abstract shape is filled with heartfelt intention. Made with mango and chocolate.

Desc.SourceString: 巨龙降落在世界之巅，张开双翼主宰天空，挥动利爪嵌入坚石，试图将这象征人类文明的高塔，变为它展示力量的王座。
Desc.LocalizedString: A mighty dragon descends upon the pinnacle of the world, spreading its wings to dominate the sky. It drives its claws into the hard rock, seeking to turn this symbol of human civilization into a throne of its might.

Desc.SourceString: 雏龙从裂开的蛋壳中探出脑袋，好奇地打量着这个世界。它用小巧的爪子扒着蛋壳边缘，任由体内的蓝色弦能向外荡漾。
Desc.LocalizedString: A hatchling dragon gazes out from its broken shell, exploring its surroundings. Clutching the shell's rim, blue String Energy pulses from within.

Desc.SourceString: 采用深渊矿石与龙瞳碎片打造的徽章，延续着魔龙审视世界的能力。睁眼时瞳光流转如熔金明镜，能看穿一切的谎言；闭目时瞳眸漆黑如深邃夜空，只会容纳真知与真理。
Desc.LocalizedString: A medal crafted from Abyssal Ore and Dragon Eye Fragments, continuing the dragon's watchful power. Open, its golden light unveils all lies; closed, its black depths hold only truth and wisdom.

Desc.SourceString: 我们不会因重重敌意而退缩，也不会因未知威胁而动摇。支撑我们前行的，是守护世界的坚定信念，与斩碎晶粹的绝对力量。
Desc.LocalizedString: Our determination against enemies and the unknown is fueled by unyielding faith and the strength to crush Evo Crystals.

Desc.SourceString: 变身器作为魔法少女的契约之证，也是其内在魔力的源泉。它不只是一颗宝石，更是愿望的容器、情感的透镜。当纯粹的心意与之同频，心灵之力便在此刻流转，绽放为璀璨的魔法。
Desc.LocalizedString: The transformation device is a symbol of the Magical Girl's contract and the source of her inner power. It's more than just a gem—it's a vessel for wishes and a lens for emotions. When pure intentions resonate with it, the power of the heart flows and blossoms into brilliant magic.

Desc.SourceString: 据说戴上它，就能被菠萝包的温暖甜蜜直击心灵！……不、不许笑，伙伴，你也一起来试试！
Desc.LocalizedString: It is said that wearing it warms your heart with the sweetness of pineapple buns... Hey, don't laugh! You, try it on!

Desc.SourceString: 前辈，星与星之间也是有牵绊与联结的，构成“双星”的两颗恒星将绕着共同的中心点长久环绕，互不分离……
Desc.LocalizedString: There are connections and bonds among stars. Two stars that make up the binary system will revolve around a center of mass in eternity. They will never be apart...

Desc.SourceString: 这是战术熊“菲”，是今天负责保护你的警卫，觉得警卫长得比坏人更危险？嘘——小熊可听不得这些……
Desc.LocalizedString: Um, this is Tactical Teddy 'Fay.' He'll, um, protect you today. Think he, uh, looks scarier than the bad guys? Shh—don't let Fay hear that...

Desc.SourceString: 经过了命运的淬炼，这副躯壳中的灵魂闪耀着坚毅的光芒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Forged by fate, this soul shines with resilience.

Desc.SourceString: 在“晶源感染”危机爆发期，普雷顿曾被大量粉尘覆盖。危机结束后，近郊区域散落了部分被析出的晶石粉末。工作人员对其进行收集分析，以避免相似的灾难再度发生。
Desc.LocalizedString: During the peak of the Outbreak incident, Preton was blanketed with dust. After the crisis ended, crystallized powder was found scattered in the suburban areas. Researchers collected and analyzed these samples to help prevent similar disasters from occurring again.

Desc.SourceString: 当道场的枫叶点燃无尽的荒原，这满弓的决意早已化作烧尽枷锁的火焰。而我向命运射出的一箭，必定会跨越天际线。
Desc.LocalizedString: When autumn leaves ignite the vast plains, this arrow is destined to break all bounds and fly beyond the horizon.

Desc.SourceString: 让我把这个发饰给您……？您想体验一下成为女仆的感觉？
Desc.LocalizedString: You want the headdress...? Are you trying to experience what it's like to be a maid?

Desc.SourceString: 心夏探险的认证收藏品。
Desc.LocalizedString: Certified collectibles from Kokona's adventures.

Desc.SourceString: 多次探险后的认证收藏品，颁给我们的寻宝专家。
Desc.LocalizedString: Certified collectible awarded to our treasure-hunting expert after numerous expeditions.

Desc.SourceString: 艺术之城的新星正在冉冉升起。
Desc.LocalizedString: A rising star in the City of Art.
